title: Replace uuencode.rs decode logic with uuencoding::scan()
description: scan_body / decode_uu_block / encoded_val / parse_begin_line are ~200 lines of duplicated UU decode. They have divergences from the reviewed uuencoding crate (case-sensitive begin, rejects empty filename, strips tabs from data lines). Replace with a call to uuencoding::scan(), mapping ScannedBlock to InlineUUBlock. begin_offset/begin_length stay u32 (absolute). is_encoding_problem = block.is_truncated. A begin-base64 UuError maps to is_encoding_problem=true with empty data.
close_reason: Replaced ~200-line custom UU decode in uuencode.rs with uuencoding::scan() delegation. Added begin-base64 test. Updated 6 test fixtures to use oracle-correct UU blocks (with terminator line).
